title: Afternoon Book Circle
description: A friendly online group that reads one book a month and meets to talk about it. New members are always welcome, and you can join even if you haven't finished the book.

title: Poetry Together
description: Read and share favorite poems in a relaxed setting. No writing experience needed. Large-print copies are provided.

title: Garden Walk Club
description: A gentle one-mile walk through the community garden, followed by tea. The path is flat and step-free, with benches along the way.

title: Tech Help Hour
description: Bring your phone or tablet and get one-on-one help from a volunteer. Learn video calls, photos, and staying safe online.

title: Evening Music Listening
description: Listen to a different decade of music each week and chat about the memories it brings back. Captions and a phone dial-in are available.
